notes:
• Find Cameras has a "Save Camera Details" button: click one camera, then this, and MXG Scout saves a text file of that camera's technical replies (model, name, live-stream details) to your Desktop. It holds no password. Send it to Dialsoft to read your exact camera model and fine-tune live video.
• To fill in camera names, type the Recordings folder (e.g. Z:) before scanning.
